description: This file defines an interface named WebFeed for an external API to a news feed system within the SuiteCRM project. It declares a single method getLatestUpdates intended to fetch recent updates, with parameters for maximum time and entries.

classes.name: WebFeed
classes.description: An interface representing an external API for a news feed system, providing the method to retrieve latest updates.

methods.name: getLatestUpdates
methods.description: Method to fetch the latest updates from the news feed system, accepting parameters for maximum time and maximum number of entries.
